A sparse grid has a bottom row containing repeated same-color marker cells (often 5). For each column containing that bottom marker, fill zero cells with the color of the nearest original nonzero value in that same column, along vertical distance. This is one-dimensional nearest-label/Voronoi extension; it propagates in both directions, not only downward. Original nonzeros, including bottom markers, remain unchanged. Other columns remain unchanged.
